result.summary: Found 1 clear visual issue: the fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the content area, causing the next restaurant card to be partially hidden. Most other elements appear visually consistent.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is cut off behind the fixed tab bar, so part of the content is not fully visible or tappable.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last card clears the fixed navigation bar, or make the bottom bar non-overlapping.
